description.zh: 用播客任务生成的文件可访问链接
description.en: The URLs of source files (such as scripts) for the AI podcast generation task.

description.zh: 播客内容生成的结果（包含播客稿、播客音频）语种选型，目前仅支持中文及英文，默认语种为中文。
description.en: The language for the generated podcast content, including both script and audio. The output will be in this language, regardless of the input language. Supported: "zh" (Chinese), "en" (English). Default: "zh".
The source text for the AI podcast generation.
The topic for generating the podcast content.

description.zh: 指定播客生成的人声音色，数组中的起始音色，为第一个对话人的音色
description.en: The voices to use for podcast generation. The first voice in the array corresponds to the first speaker.

description.zh: 当前请求所使用的百炼业务空间id
description.en: The ID of the Model Studio workspace for the current request.
